From: To Do | Doing | Doing
To:
Focus On Next | Focusing | Review
To Try | Trying | Review

Subtle shifts in language can be powerful.
Combining the "roadmap" with "a board" can be powerful
#prodmgmt #ux #design #leanagile

Beginning to think that 70hr weeks are spent handling the noise/lack of focus generated from other people working 70hr weeks. It is a wicked cycle that rarely helps the business...but that gives the *impression* that doing more at once is possible.

When asked for help in hiring a PM, I ask the person to force rank a list...
